summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching its monthly HKEX equity-issuer return (FF301) for October 2026. No shares were issued or repurchased: issued shares held at 4,531,784,801 with zero treasury shares, authorised capital unchanged at USD 40 million, and option scheme balances shifted only marginally, with no funds raised. The company confirmed compliance with the 25% minimum public float threshold. This is a routine Hong Kong listing-rule housekeeping disclosure rather than a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation or advisors apply, and there is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
